text: A hollow groan, unlike anything she had ever heard in her life, came from the front, followed by a shout of “Hoi there!” The lantern hanging at her waggon had gone out, but another was shining in her face—much brighter than her own had been. Something terrible had happened. The harness was entangled with an object which blocked the way. In consternation Tess jumped down, and discovered the dreadful truth. The groan had proceeded from her father’s poor horse Prince.
